item.text:
Implemented [ContactForm.tsx](/workspace/app/ContactForm.tsx) with name, email, and message fields and an inline server action. The action checks that each value is a nonblank string before accepting the submission.

Valid messages are logged on the server, following the project’s existing simulated save pattern; the project has no contact storage service. The production build and TypeScript check passed.
